about.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

name: v1.4.242
body:
## Lighter on memory, Claude subagents a click away, and remote servers that remember 🪄

This release is lighter on memory, with lower memory use in the terminal host and WSL connections, plus less idle CPU use in terminals. It also lets you open Claude subagents straight from the sidebar, makes Codex chats in Ask mode ask before editing, and helps paired servers, SSH and WSL hosts keep your tabs and explain failures. This release also fixes problems across Windows, Linux and macOS.

## The short version

- **Open Claude subagents from the sidebar:** Click a Claude subagent row in the sidebar or dashboard to open its transcript in the same terminal, then click the parent to go back. An eye marks the one you’re viewing.
- **Chats that ask first:** Codex chats in Ask mode now ask before editing your workspace, remote Claude terminals on paired servers can continue in Chat, and chats that can’t start tell you why.
- **Agents resume as you left them:** Resumed Claude sessions keep their effort level and launch flags, Codex keeps the permission you last gave it, and Session History finds chats in more folders and on servers.
- **Remote servers that remember:** Paired servers keep your tabs across restarts, closed tabs stay closed, WSL hosts stop re-pairing after each restart, and SSH failures say what actually went wrong.
- **Lighter on memory:** Terminals use far less idle CPU, the terminal host uses less memory once it next restarts, WSL connections need much less memory, and the resource panel now matches Activity Monitor on macOS.
- **Fixes from the community:** Spaced Windows launcher paths, Korean input, DST in automations, focus-follows-mouse, tab dragging and Linux packages all work better.

**Phone & web updates:** Phones now explain an unreachable computer instead of spinning forever, and streaming replies and long web chats redraw less. Terminal programs that ask the terminal a question also keep working while a phone watches at desktop size.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Codex chats in Ask mode:** Ask now runs read-only and asks before workspace edits; Approve for me and Full access are unchanged, and work already running keeps its grant. Chats on a paired server keep the old behavior until that server is updated.
- **Claude subagent navigation:** On by default with Claude status hooks. Orca loads its plugin only into Orca panes and adds one shortcut, the first free of Ctrl+Alt+G, H or V, to `keybindings.json` in each Claude folder it uses. Turn it off in Settings → Agents → Claude subagent navigation to remove that shortcut. Claude sessions already running need a fresh launch.
- **Paired servers:** Moving a pane into a new tab and continuing a remote Claude terminal in Chat need the server to run this release. On older servers the move stays in this window only, as before, and Continue in Chat UI shows disabled with an update hint.
- **Claude account switching:** Switching accounts now also offers to restart sessions running in your System default Claude folder when that folder is signed in to the old account. The dialog groups sessions into those on the old account, others, and ones it can’t move.
- **WSL hosts:** Connections to a WSL host’s server now go through bash and fall back to Node when bash is missing or too old. This needs no server update and works with any server version.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Codex asks before editing, remote terminals continue in Chat, and chats that can’t start say why.*

* Ask before Codex workspace edits in Ask mode, and apply permission changes to each fresh turn by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31299
* Continue remote Claude terminal conversations in Chat on paired servers, from the pane or Session History by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33954
* Send launch prompts and worker tasks through the retrying start so a first failed start doesn’t lose them by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33832
* Show a start failure after one try when the agent’s answer can never succeed on a retry by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33685
* Say why Claude refused to start a chat, including Full access while running as root by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33812
* Make Stop pause Codex goal work, and start Set and Resume with the composer’s saved model and effort by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33631
* Give a chat a fresh automatic name after /clear, while keeping names you set by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32287
* Show chat-only workspaces as active before the first message by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33815
* Keep a Pi chat open when Pi sends an event over 8 MiB, such as a large inline image by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33651
* Remove the usage-limit Continue button that could hit the same limit again by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33392
* Keep link and file actions in a chat context menu reopened right after another by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33725
* Keep retained chat panes from jumping before their layout is ready by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33788
* Keep chat button hover colors readable when the theme changes by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33791
* Stop retrying a failing rename for old chat names made only of invisible characters by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33678

### Agent launch, status & accounts

*Navigate Claude subagents, resume agents with the settings they had, and see the right status and history.*

* Open a Claude subagent’s view from the sidebar or dashboard, and track which one Claude is showing by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33322
* Keep agents you set separately when you pick a permission for all agents by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33018
* Resume Claude sessions at their own effort level by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33765
* Keep a background agent launch’s flags when it is resumed by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33776
* Resume a Codex thread with the permission it was last given, not Orca’s launch flag by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33460
* Offer to restart System default Claude sessions signed in to the old account when switching accounts by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33793
* Keep MiMo’s login and sessions while Orca adds its status plugin by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33668
* Deliver Kimi’s first prompt on Windows and after Kimi is ready by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33581
* Let Codex’s stricter Windows sandbox read Orca’s managed Codex folder by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33748
* Show Claude and Codex panes as waiting while the folder-trust dialog is open by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33804
* Recognize a hand-typed Claude at its startup dialogs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33826
* Stop false Antigravity needs-attention from tab titles and auto-approved prompts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33671
* Keep Codex’s hidden title-writing prompt off the sidebar heading by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33746
* Keep a Pi row working while a pi-subagents child is still running by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33738
* Keep Hermes named profiles reporting status to their pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33742
* Stop a Codex run inside a Claude background job from labelling the Claude pane as Codex by @stakost in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24641
* Detect Grok CLI installed only in ~/.grok/bin by @brynnclaw in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25324
* List Claude sessions from a wrapper script’s or launch setting’s CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR in Agent Session History by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33751
* List OpenCode sessions from Orca-managed data accounts in Agent Session History by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33658
* Resume OpenCode sessions under the account that owns them by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33753
* List a chat once, under the app that wrote it, when Pi and OMP share a sessions folder by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33647
* Delete a server-hosted session on the server that owns it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33906
* Resume a server session whose workspace was deleted, and show previews for remote search hits by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33965
* Send only an error code, not the raw message, when reporting a failed agent hook install by @brynnclaw in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25287

### Orchestration & CLI

*Workers report to the right coordinator and read all their mail, and CLI commands fail clearly.*

* Stop workers from taking over the Run they work for by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29008
* Teach workers to acknowledge and drain mail batches so newer messages aren’t hidden by @1aifanatic in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26768
* Keep a worker’s finished report when a late startup step fails by @1aifanatic in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26762
* Keep paging forward through a worker transcript after a page fills by @kaznowski in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32894
* Show a terminal’s orphaned state in plain `orca terminal list` and `show` output by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33910
* Reject empty --terminal and --from handles instead of falling back to defaults by @Cunninger in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/16745
* Accept an empty --value in browser fill and select commands by @2sumtech in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/16030
* Teach agents about `orca terminal read --screen`, and fix two `orca --help` lines by @webdevtodayjason in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/15893
* Correct the split --direction wording in the CLI guide agents read by @kaynansc in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/9038
* Press the requested named keys and hotkey letters in computer use on Linux by @AlgoraAndrew in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22494
* Let computer use set text fields on Linux systems such as Ubuntu 24.04 by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/10586
* Press the plain shortcut for uppercase hotkey letters in computer use on Windows by @jespo2021 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27642

### Terminals

*Lighter terminal hosts, cleaner repaints, and fixes for Windows, Linux, macOS and Korean input.*

* Start every terminal through one path, so simultaneous starts from the window and the CLI or phone share one result by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32076
* Inspect idle local shell panes less often, cutting terminal host memory and idle CPU by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33829
* Cap the terminal host’s short-lived memory so it stays smaller when idle and after bursts by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33837
* Keep a pane moved into a new tab in its new tab on paired servers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33027
* Answer terminal queries in output sent just as a paired terminal is paused, so fish doesn’t freeze by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33749
* Answer terminal queries in parked output a paused paired terminal discards by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33783
* Open another client’s terminal under its own tab instead of a second copy by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33978
* Stop lines drawing twice and color codes showing as text when you return to a hidden pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33880
* Skip a half-sent color or title code when a hidden pane’s restore is abandoned by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33905
* Repaint Codex and Claude Code over the skipped-hidden-output notice by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33835
* Save output once for in-app terminals running behind a degraded terminal host by @Muriano in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33119
* Return a tab from the chat view to the terminal once you’re back at the shell after quitting an agent by @zhangxaochen in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30614
* Stop a closed terminal from being reported as stuck while its history was still loading by @dansolombrino in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31095
* Keep your scrolled-up reading position in place as old scrollback is trimmed by @Meapri in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23334
* Keep typed keys held for a starting agent from blocking stuck-pane recovery by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33865
* Keep find-bar highlights when moving between matches with Cmd+G and Cmd+Shift+G by @AntonioKL in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18844
* Send a word jump once, not twice, while Korean input is composing by @ethznn in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/17624
* Let focus-follows-mouse move between the floating and main workspace terminals by @oha-4 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29914
* Stop new terminals inheriting Claude Code’s nested-session variables when Orca was started from Claude Code by @Baek-Seunghyun in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/10188
* Send real Alt+Left/Right in local Windows terminals so Codex can switch agents by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33463
* Notice when an agent launched in Windows PowerShell exits by @hwantage in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18182
* Run Windows launchers from folders with spaces or parentheses by @thsvkd in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/13501
* Keep terminals working on Linux with glibc 2.42 and newer by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33803
* Warn in the log when Linux terminals inherit a limit that kills long-running jobs by @JacobHonore in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29762
* Stop several macOS terminals opened at once from waiting 3 seconds for a shell by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33833
* Track terminals and agent sessions on Macs set to other languages and regions by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33898
* Read macOS processes with no terminal correctly by @aashish254 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23251

*Paired servers keep your tabs, WSL hosts stay paired and lighter, and SSH errors say what went wrong.*

* Keep a paired server’s workspace tabs across desktop restarts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33926
* Stop closed tabs coming back after a restart on a host moved to its managed server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33702
* Keep a closed browser tab on a paired server closed after Orca quits without a clean shutdown by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33972
* Remove terminal tabs a paired server closed, and offer Close Pane on a closed remote terminal by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33949
* Remember which tab you switched to with the keyboard on a paired server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33761

* Refuse a second Orca server on a host cloned with the same machine id, and say how to fix it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33775

* Explain that a headless host can’t share artifacts or skills yet by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33754

* Stop a server’s idle session-history helper after a minute to save memory by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33845
